name: Cupertino Techie Teens
what_you_do: Help adults 50 and older at the Cupertino Senior Center use their phones, tablets, and computers. At the end of summer you make and give a 30-minute workshop.
who_can_apply: Anyone ages 14 to 18 may apply. You must be at least 14 by the first day of training. Space is limited.
pay_detail: Unpaid volunteer role. If picked, you pay $30 to cover fingerprinting, a program shirt, a name tag, and training materials.
duration: In 2026: training on June 8, then a 2-hour shift every week from June 10 to August 7.
deadline_text: The summer 2026 application closed Friday, March 27, 2026 at 4 p.m. The page says the next application opens in February 2027. The 2027 closing date is not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Send the Techie Teen application, the signed volunteer agreement, and answers to supplemental questions. Picks are based on your answers, an interview (mid-April in 2026), and your availability. Late applications are not accepted.
notes: You must attend all training, be fingerprinted and cleared, and bring your own ride (VTA and Silicon Valley Hopper are options). Staff can sign off on service hours. 2027 dates will likely follow the 2026 pattern.
